INSERT INTO admin_notification (admin_user_id, type, severity, title, body, ref_type, ref_id, status) SELECT DISTINCT ur.user_id, #{type}, #{severity}, #{title}, #{body}, 'SURVEY', #{refId}, 'UNREAD' FROM user_roles ur JOIN roles r ON r.code = ur.role_code WHERE r.code IN ('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN')
